bounded_audit.real_objective: Select and specify a future measurement surface, not execute behavior measurement.
bounded_audit.strongest_baseline_explanation: A lookup table, transition table, FSM, graph cache, episodic traversal, recency heuristic, or action-effect frequency model may solve a weak future object without any self-boundary mechanism.
bounded_audit.strongest_invalidity_reason: The selected class has a prior invalid-harness example; the new measurement object must explicitly exclude oracle-target tautology, answer-bearing legal fields, omitted fair simple baselines, proxy leakage, benign answer aliases, and replay tautology.
bounded_audit.falsification_condition: Close or block if the selected object cannot avoid lookup/FSM/oracle collapse or if intervention-response persistence can be specified with a stronger cheap-baseline challenge and cleaner ablation.
bounded_audit.insufficient_evidence: This task does not produce mechanism evidence, performance scores, candidate behavior, ablation sensitivity, or replay evidence.

action_conditioned_self_boundary.measures_concrete_future_behavior_state_: yes, if specified as future action/output plus boundary-state update conditioned on action-effect self/external evidence
action_conditioned_self_boundary.replayable_from_serialized_state_plus_ob: yes, as recomputation of boundary-state update and future behavior from serialized boundary state plus current observation
action_conditioned_self_boundary.independent_callable_cheap_baseline_spec: yes: lookup, transition table, FSM, graph-cache, episodic traversal, action-effect frequency without boundary state, recency, majority/random, oracle-leak positive control
action_conditioned_self_boundary.real_mechanism_removing_ablation_specifi: yes: freeze self-boundary update, remove action-conditioned contingency update, randomize action/effect linkage, remove counterfactual no-action comparison, collapse self/external channels
action_conditioned_self_boundary.leakage_positive_control_specifiable: yes: inject future outcome fields, self/external labels, action-index or context-key target aliases, benign answer aliases, or direct action-effect answer encodings
action_conditioned_self_boundary.governance_proxy_collapse_risk: high unless the measurement object is behavior/state/output and explicitly excludes the old admission-wrapper shape
action_conditioned_self_boundary.cheap_heuristic_collapse_risk: high unless heldout counterfactual action/effect structures make action-effect frequency and transition tables insufficient
action_conditioned_self_boundary.bounded_functional_subject_alignment: stronger because it directly targets self/external boundary update from action-conditioned contingency evidence

intervention_response_update_persistence.measures_concrete_future_behavior_state_: yes, if specified as delayed future behavior after intervention plus persistence state
intervention_response_update_persistence.replayable_from_serialized_state_plus_ob: yes, as recomputation of delayed post-intervention behavior from serialized update/persistence state plus new observation
intervention_response_update_persistence.independent_callable_cheap_baseline_spec: yes: last-observation, recency, fixed flip-after-intervention, transition table, FSM, episodic retrieval, majority/random, oracle-leak positive control
intervention_response_update_persistence.real_mechanism_removing_ablation_specifi: yes but less specific: freeze update, remove persistence/consolidation, reset after intervention, remove delayed-use memory
intervention_response_update_persistence.leakage_positive_control_specifiable: yes: inject hidden rule labels, intervention flags encoding the answer, future affordance fields, context IDs, or delayed-use labels
intervention_response_update_persistence.governance_proxy_collapse_risk: moderate if persistence becomes manifest completeness or delayed-use field presence
intervention_response_update_persistence.cheap_heuristic_collapse_risk: higher by default because recency or fixed flip-after-intervention may match many designs
intervention_response_update_persistence.bounded_functional_subject_alignment: weaker for this route because it is more generic adaptation evidence and less specific to self-boundary

selection_rationale: action_conditioned_self_boundary is selected because it can bind action-conditioned contingency, self/external boundary update, future behavior, mechanism-removing ablation, and cheap-baseline pressure into a single measurement object. The class is selected only as a new specification target; the existing action-conditioned preflight remains blocked negative evidence.

selected_surface_specification.state: Serialized bounded self-boundary state containing prior action-effect contingency evidence, controllable-channel vs external-channel belief distribution, uncertainty, prior boundary state, intervention ledger, and delayed-use markers. It must not contain answer-bearing labels, future outcomes, action-index target aliases, context IDs as target keys, oracle fields, or benign named answer aliases.
selected_surface_specification.observation: Current environment observation plus allowed prior action/effect observations. Legal fields must be sufficient for a nontrivial legal reference to exceed random/majority while still denying direct target labels, future outcome fields, hidden rule labels, row IDs, context IDs, and answer-bearing action names.
selected_surface_specification.intervention: Perturb action-to-effect contingency or self/external channel structure while holding superficial context features insufficient for lookup; include counterfactual no-action or externally-caused effects, decoy effects, and heldout action/effect structures.
selected_surface_specification.measured_future_behavior_or_state_update: Future action selection or output conditioned on updated action-effect boundary evidence; boundary-state update after intervention; downstream behavior that distinguishes self-caused effects from external-only or decoy effects.
selected_surface_specification.independent_callable_baseline: Independently implemented lookup table, transition table, FSM planner, graph-cache, episodic traversal, action-effect frequency model without self-boundary state, recency/win-stay-lose-shift heuristic, majority/random controls, and oracle-leakage positive control.
selected_surface_specification.real_mechanism_removing_ablation: Freeze self-boundary update; remove action-conditioned contingency update; randomize action/effect linkage; remove counterfactual no-action comparison; collapse self/external channel distinction.
selected_surface_specification.leakage_positive_control: Inject future outcome fields, self/external oracle labels, action-index target aliases, context IDs as target keys, benign named answer aliases, or direct action-effect answer encodings, and require scanner detection.
selected_surface_specification.replay_from_serialized_state_plus_observ: Recompute boundary-state update and future behavior from serialized self-boundary state plus current observation through the same callable path used by the candidate-facing measurement; stored hashes, verdicts, reports, and evaluator-only target functions are not replay.
selected_surface_specification.graph_cache_lookup_transition_table_fsm_: Mandatory and decisive if challengers match or beat the candidate under heldout interventions while receiving the same legal inputs.
selected_surface_specification.block_or_close_condition: Close or block if the object measures governance proxies; if legal fields encode the target; if no independent cheap baseline can be specified; if no mechanism-removing ablation can be specified; if replay cannot recompute from serialized state plus observation; if leakage positive controls cannot be defined; if lookup/FSM/transition-table/graph-cache/episodic traversal challenge is not meaningful; or if implementation is required before the measurement object is clear.
selected_surface_specification.strongest_baseline: Transition table / FSM / graph-cache / episodic traversal over legal state, action, and effect observations, backed by action-effect frequency without self-boundary state.
selected_surface_specification.strongest_objection: Prior action-conditioned self-boundary work already failed as an invalid harness because a legal interface encoded the target, fair simple baselines were omitted, and replay became tautological. A weak new specification would repeat that failure instead of producing a discriminative behavior-bearing surface.
selected_surface_specification.why_the_rejected_surface_loses_or_is_def: intervention_response_update_persistence is deferred because it can be behavior-bearing but is more easily explained by recency, last observation, or fixed flip-after-intervention. It is a fallback only if this self-boundary object cannot block oracle/lookup/FSM collapse.
selected_surface_specification.next_minimal_closed_loop_action: Draft a separate bounded no-implementation measurement-object task card for action_conditioned_self_boundary that encodes these blockers before any runner, validator, candidate, Gate, bridge, tournament, runtime, or EGO-mainline work.
